newsitem.title: USA: Reliv November sales up 52 percent.
newsitem.headline: Reliv November sales up 52 percent.

text.p: Reliv International Inc, which makes and markets nutritional supplements, said on Monday that sales from its U.S. operations during November rose 52 percent over a year ago to more than $3.2 million.

Reliv said a new product, Arthaffect, contributed to the sales gains in November. Reliv launched Arthaffect in October. The product includes an ingredient which has been clinically reported to nutritionally support healthy joint function, the company said in a statement.
Shares of Reliv were trading unchanged at six.
